command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: write persistent sysctl config"
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Persistently disable ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "STEP: apply immediately"
sudo -n /usr/sbin/sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "STEP: apply to all existing interfaces explicitly too"
sudo -n /usr/sbin/sysctl --system >/dev/null

echo "STEP: verify runtime values"
sudo -n /usr/sbin/sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects \

  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
